notes: The page at rest inside the shell: the title, the list, the first release card, its version line and its first note. `origin` is the title, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the first release card, because it is the region both clients draw identically. The page draws the list only for the shell's user agent (a browser visitor gets the app-only notice), so a recording has to visit as the shell; the surface is declared here and not yet under `docs/mobile/visual-gate.json`, which is why it is ported and switched off (#951, ADR-0117). Widths of the version and notes are left out deliberately - they are the run of the words, not a decision. Colours are left out too - they are what the raster proves.
